title: Juicy Grilled Malaysian Sausages Skewers
description: A cultured and crumbly Malaysian dish featuring sausages with a yuzu-cure, perfect for a date night, with Mediterranean-friendly flavors. This recipe combines the spices of Malaysia with the brightness of yuzu for a unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, lemon zest, salt, and black pepper.
Add the Malaysian sausages to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated sausages onto skewers, leaving a small space between each sausage.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausages are cooked through.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of quinoa or roasted vegetables for a complete meal.
Refrigerate or freeze leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat cooked sausages in the microwave or oven until warmed through.
